assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: GitHub README conceptual workflow graphic, wide landscape. Design an exceptionally clear premium technical infographic for Market Intelligence in near-black charcoal #0b1216, pale white typography, mint teal #55d9bd and muted slate. Exactly five equally weighted columns with simple tasteful geometric iconography, thin connected arrows and generous spacing. Top title exactly 'THE DAILY RESEARCH LOOP'. Left-to-right primary labels exactly 'Market', 'Industries', 'Stocks', 'ChartBook', 'Watchlists + Journal'. Smaller labels below respectively exactly 'Assess participation', 'Find strengthening groups', 'Filter and rank', 'Review every setup once', 'Capture decisions'. Market icon is paired green/red breadth strokes; industries icon a subtle heatmap grid; stocks icon a ranking grid; ChartBook icon candles and a keyboard key; final icon a bookmark and note. Keep text large and exact, no extra text, no numerical market data, no decorative clutter, no watermark, no finance brand logos. Clean flat infographic with subtle depth only, opaque background. All typography must be crisp single-layer typesetting: no doubled letters, no ghost text, no overlapping copies. Pay special attention to the exact subtitle Assess participation. Keep generous separation between every label and icon.
